newsitem.title: FRANCE: France sees lower 97 winter barley, rapeseed crops.
newsitem.headline: France sees lower 97 winter barley, rapeseed crops.

text.p: France's farm ministry predicted on Wednesday that France may harvest less winter barley and winter rapeseed in 1997 than in the previous year, mostly due to lower yields.

In its first estimate for the new harvest, the ministry said the winter barley crop might drop 1.4 percent to 6.748 million tonnes over 1996 and the winter rapeseed crop by 3.3 percent to 2.767 million.
The ministry's estimate assumes winter barley yields would decline to 5.87 tonnes per hectare from 6.35 tonnes in 1996 and winter rapeseed yields fall to 2.94 tonnes from 3.33 tonnes previously.
Winter barley area is expected to rise to 1.149 million hectares from 1.077 million nd winter rapeseed area to 941,000 hectares from 860,000.
The ministry specified that yield estimates were drawn up from data provided by crop exports while sowings estimates resulted from a survey of 18,000 farmers.
